floor-jpn-cedar.notes: Wood plank floor tiled 3x3. Planks align seamlessly with staggered joints; no seam line, step, or repeating blotch shows. Reads clearly as wooden plank flooring from above at table distance.

floor-jpn-moss.notes: Grass ground texture tiled 3x3. Shows a prominent repeating blotch pattern of flower clusters and lighting variation across the 3x3 tiles, though without a hard edge seam line. Reads as grass/meadow from above at table distance.

floor-tatami.notes: Green tatami rush matting with dark fabric borders (tatami-beri) tiled 3x3. Continuous vertical strips with no visible seam lines, steps, or repeating blotches. Reads clearly as tatami mat flooring from above at table distance.

decal-stepping-stones.notes: Flat natural stone paver / garden stepping stone (tobi-ishi) with mossy edges on a chroma-key blue background.

room-jpn-dojo.notes: Dojo interior featuring a wooden floor, shoji screen wall, katana weapon rack, taiko drum on stand, kamidana shrine shelf, and kamon banner.

room-jpn-garden.notes: Traditional Japanese garden featuring a stone lantern (tōrō), bamboo water spout and basin (tsukubai), bamboo fence (takegaki), stepping stones, and red maple.

room-jpn-house.notes: Traditional Japanese room with tatami mats, shoji screens, low table (chabudai), zabuton cushions, and tokonoma alcove with hanging scroll and flower vase.

room-jpn-shop.notes: Traditional Japanese sake shop or brewery featuring stacked sake barrels (komodaru), low table with sake flask, and a hanging cedar ball (sugidama) under the eaves.

room-jpn-shrine-court.what: Shinto shrine entrance / water purification pavilion (chōzuya)
room-jpn-shrine-court.notes: Shinto shrine grounds featuring a vermilion torii gate with shimenawa rope, stone lanterns, and a water purification pavilion (chōzuya/temizuya) with stone basin.

room-jpn-shrine.notes: Shinto shrine prayer hall with vermilion wooden structure, suzu bell with red-and-white rope, saisen offering box, shimenawa, and altar.

room-jpn-teahouse.notes: Japanese tea room featuring a sunken hearth (ro) with cast iron kettle (tetsubin), tea whisk and bowl, tatami flooring, shoji screen, and tokonoma alcove with chabana.

type-JPN.notes: Traditional Japanese house with tiled roof (kawara), illuminated shoji screens, exposed timber framing, and a wrap-around wooden veranda (engawa).
